verdict.rationale: Docs confirm verification 'levels' as configurable sequences of steps with many check types and adjustable AML screening settings, implying dashboard-based configuration rather than code changes (sumsub-docs-5, sumsub-docs-6). However, there is no explicit evidence of conditional branching logic, risk-based routing rules, or country-specific requirement templates being configurable without an engineering deploy. Missing for 10: explicit no-code workflow/conditional-logic builder documentation, evidence of risk-based routing configuration, and country-specific rule templates managed purely via UI without deploys.
